trigger.label: Export Reports (ZIP)
trigger.tooltip: Export a ZIP of report PDFs, one per student

description.bulk_one: Generates a ZIP of report PDFs for the {{count}} selected submission.
description.bulk_other: Generates a ZIP of report PDFs for the {{count}} selected submissions.
description.all: Generates a ZIP of report PDFs for all submissions matching the current filter.

regenerateLabel: Regenerate reports even if one already exists for a student

toasts.alreadyRunning: An export for this assessment is already running — showing its progress.
toasts.startFailed: Failed to start the export. Please try again.
toasts.downloadNotReady: The download link is not ready yet. Please try again in a moment.

warnings.contextDrift: Class statistics were recalculated partway through this export — some reports may quote slightly different numbers than others in this ZIP.
warnings.staleItems_one: {{count}} report was generated before the student's attempt was updated (e.g. re-evaluated). Regenerate the export to refresh them.
warnings.staleItems_other: {{count}} reports were generated before the student's attempt was updated (e.g. re-evaluated). Regenerate the export to refresh them.

zipContentsNote.suffix: to view and open each student's report.
